source_title: Bulletproof Named to 2026 CRN AI Innovators List
source_excerpt:
BOSTON , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bulletproof announced today that it has been recognized by CRN Â® , a brand of The Channel Company , on their inaugural 2026 CRN AI Innovators list.
The list recognizes North American solution providers leading the way in AI innovation, including managed service providers, value-added resellers, systems integrators, and consultants. Honorees are recognized for their technical expertise and ability to develop and deliver AI-focused solutions that create meaningful customer impact.
As organizations move from AI experimentation toward practical adoption, many face complex questions around readiness, data security, governance, compliance, and measurable value. Bulletproof helps customers address these challenges with a secure, structured approach that connects AI initiatives to business priorities.
With deep Microsoft expertise, Bulletproof supports organizations across the AI journey, from assessing their technology and data foundations to preparing for Microsoft 365 Copilot, strengthening governance, securing sensitive information, and building a roadmap for responsible adoption. This approach helps customers move forward with greater clarity, reduce risk, and turn AI investments into meaningful business outcomes.
"This recognition reflects the strength of our team and the trust our customers place in us as they navigate a rapidly changing technology landscape," said Guido Timmerman, President of Bulletproof. "Our focus is on making AI practical, secure, compliant, and valuable for the organizations we serve. That means helping customers build the right foundations, put effective governance in place, and move from ideas to measurable outcomes with confidence
The full list is available on the CRN AI Innovators 2026 page .
